BRBC Monday Social Ride

Leawood, KS · Road · Social

BRBC Monday Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Leawood, KS. It rolls every Monday at 6:30 pm from Elite Cycling at Mission Farms.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @blueriverbicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BRBC Monday Social Ride group ride

A relaxed 15-mile loop through the neighborhoods around Mission Farms, good for recovery days and for beginners. A sweep rider holds 12 mph so nobody is left. The club's Saturday rides are faster: a 7:15 am coffee ride and a 9 am 40-mile drop ride with regroups.
